title: Can Non-tiered Customer Loyalty Programs Be Profitable?
eligible_reason: Loyalty program introduced at one date (end of week 40) for automatically enrolled members vs. non-members. The DiD is on hidden-Markov-model transition probabilities (attrition), estimated in a structural or latent-state model, not a TWFE regression with staggered adoption. Data are simulated.
design_notes: Simulation Files/analyze_GJNT_data.R estimates the attrition DiD (DID.theta21.table) on simul_GJNTdata.csv: 187 simulated frequent customers (segment 6), 80 members and 107 non-members, 120 weekly spend columns, program at week 40. SimulationCode-GJNT.pdf documents it.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Program introduced for all members at week 40.
data_access: proprietary (retailer data); package ships simulated data only
data_files_note: README PDF: 'As the data set in the paper is proprietary, we provide a sample simulated data set.'
priority_note: Single date, model-based outcome, simulated data.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text).
